scope: Performance investigation of existing idle offline checkpoint-file restoration; no new public APIs or admission changes; unreleased checkpoint-executions branch.

environment.location: Disposable nested KVM lab on ssh linux; no workload measurements on macOS or the physical host
environment.guest: Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, kernel 6.8.0-139-generic, 4 vCPUs, 8 GiB, no swap
environment.privileged_worker_caveat: The root service had the same nominal memory/CPU/task limits, but smolvm placed VMMs in separate per-VM systemd scopes. The service limit was not an aggregate VMM budget. The outer QEMU bound remained. Do not pool these samples with ordinary-user runs.

privileged_precomputed.purpose: Additional baseline after adding a serialized table to the fixture; kept separate from the original artifact pair.

protocol.cache_configuration: Disabled sets SMOLVM_DISABLE_SHARED_EXTRACT=1; enabled omits the variable entirely. Setting it to 0 still disables extraction. Separate root/user data roots, caches reused within each campaign.
protocol.cache_evidence: Enabled worker logs contain vms/_shared/ paths and per-machine restore phase timings. Disabled logs do not. The upstream re-extracted evicted shared pack message can also appear for already materialized bare packs; it is not counted as proof of a cache miss.
protocol.ordering: One excluded warmup per source, then alternate image/checkpoint order each iteration; no measured samples removed.
protocol.dataset: One million deterministic CSV rows: station=i%1000, value=(i*37)%10000. Compress on disk, aggregate counts/sums for 1000 stations in /dev/shm. Every query returns 42 1000 5054000 followed by newline. Checkpoint captured only after preparation commands finished; no background application.
protocol.image_baselines: dataset rebuilds the RAM table; dataset-precomputed copies the serialized table from the same image instead. Both assert no preexisting RAM table. Each artifact pair came from the same guest; capture then stop/export with workspace.
protocol.timing: Low-level Client wall-clock milliseconds. Time to result sums create+start+preparation+query per sample. Checkpoint create includes worker-version preflight. Medians of individual phases must not be summed to infer median total.
protocol.phase_logs: Server api_restore_* elapsed milliseconds joined by machine name; integer durations do not cover every client/HTTP/registration cost.
protocol.script_revision_note: Rounds 1–4 used the extended benchmark before dataset-precomputed was added. Rounds 5–9 used the final hashed benchmark and final fixture script. Raw timings and matched server phases are retained for every sample.

setup_issues.issue: First privileged fixture start returned HTTP 500 because the isolated VM uid could not read the runtime libraries extracted with private permissions.
setup_issues.resolution: Made the nonsecret runtime distribution readable, identity-checked disposal of the failed source, and regenerated fixtures before any timed sample. No isolation controls disabled.
setup_issues.remaining_scope: An empty systemd scope from that failed source remained active after all runs; its cgroup.procs was empty, then it was explicitly stopped.

setup_issues.issue: Initial local Dialyzer invocation used dev environment and reported missing EEx functions.
setup_issues.resolution: Re-ran the required gate with MIX_ENV=test; zero errors. No code suppression added.

limitations: Nested fresh image boots were much slower than earlier native runs; do not infer native/macOS speedups from image/checkpoint ratios here.
Small warm-cache samples, variable shared-host scheduling, no confidence intervals or production tail-latency claim.
This tests local .smolcheckpoint file restores, not live branching or checkpoint:// prepared references.
Tiny serializable RAM table; no retained Python interpreter, imported libraries, server process or arbitrary resumed workload.
No durable store/controller overhead measured; no change to qualified isolation/resource guarantees.
Capture/preparation amortization depends on reuse count and is not measured.
Enabling shared extraction was tested for these fixtures, not a full new deployment security qualification.

runs.limitations: Alternating source order after one warmup each; warm host caches, local approved artifacts, no image download or checkpoint capture time. Low-level Client timings, not durable managed runtime latency. Cache mode is an operator declaration; verify actual cache use in server logs.
